name: fortivpn-gateway
description: Kubernetes-based FortiVPN gateway with automatic Microsoft SAML authentication and BGP routing to MikroTik.

cookie.purpose: Automates Microsoft SAML authentication via Selenium and 1Password CLI; writes session cookie to /shared volume.

vpn.purpose: Runs OpenFortiVPN client; reads cookie from /shared volume; establishes PPP tunnel.

bgp.purpose: Runs BIRD BGP daemon; peers with MikroTik router; advertises VPN routes.

key_files.cookie_auth.py: Selenium-based SAML cookie extraction script (Microsoft SSO + 1Password + OTP).
key_files.scripts/bird.conf.template: BIRD BGP daemon configuration template (envsubst-rendered at runtime).
key_files.scripts/e2e-local-k8s.sh: Local E2E validator for the running Kubernetes deployment.
key_files.secret.yaml.example: Template for Kubernetes Secret (OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN, VPN_GATEWAY, BGP_* vars).
